note: Pricing changes often. Verify against the vendor's pricing page before quoting a number in a post if it's been more than ~60 days since verified_date.

tools.name: ChatGPT Business
tools.description: An AI assistant for day-to-day writing, research, and planning, with admin controls and 60+ work-app integrations (Slack, Google Drive, SharePoint, GitHub) so it can draw on your company's own files instead of just the open internet.
tools.best_for: Any small business that wants one AI tool the whole team can use, with company data kept out of model training by default.
tools.pricing: $20/user/mo billed annually (2-seat minimum) or $25/mo billed monthly

tools.name: Claude Team
tools.description: Anthropic's team plan for Claude: shared workspaces, admin permissions, and access to Claude for day-to-day writing, research, and reasoning tasks.
tools.best_for: Teams that want strong writing and reasoning quality and are fine committing to a 5-seat minimum.
tools.pricing: $25/user/mo for standard seats, 5-seat minimum ($125/mo minimum spend)

tools.name: Canva Pro
tools.description: AI-assisted design tool (Magic Studio) for social graphics, presentations, and marketing materials — no design skill required.
tools.best_for: Any small business making its own social posts, flyers, or presentations in-house.
tools.pricing: Pro $18/mo ($144/yr); Business (multi-user) $25/user/mo

tools.name: Grammarly
tools.description: AI writing assistant that checks grammar, tone, and clarity across email, docs, and social captions as you type.
tools.best_for: Solo founders who write a lot of their own customer-facing copy and want a second set of eyes.
tools.pricing: Free tier available; Pro $12/mo billed annually (or $30/mo monthly)

tools.name: Jasper
tools.description: AI content generator built for on-brand marketing copy — blog posts, ads, and social captions trained on your brand voice.
tools.best_for: Businesses producing marketing content regularly enough to justify a dedicated tool over a general assistant.
tools.pricing: Pro $59/mo billed annually (or $69/mo monthly); Business tier custom-priced

tools.name: HubSpot Breeze AI
tools.description: AI agents built into HubSpot's CRM that qualify leads and resolve routine customer conversations automatically.
tools.best_for: Growing businesses already on HubSpot that want AI handling first-touch sales and support conversations.
tools.pricing: Requires HubSpot Professional ($90/seat/mo annual) plus outcome-based AI fees, e.g. $0.50 per resolved conversation

tools.name: Zapier
tools.description: Connects your apps and automates repetitive tasks; its AI layer lets you describe an automation in plain English instead of building it step by step.
tools.best_for: Any business drowning in manual copy-paste between tools (forms to CRM to email to spreadsheet).
tools.pricing: Free (100 tasks/mo, 2-step Zaps only); Professional from $29.99/mo (750 tasks, multi-step Zaps)

tools.name: QuickBooks Online (Intuit Assist)
tools.description: Bookkeeping software with a built-in AI assistant that answers plain-language questions about cash flow, invoices, and profit.
tools.best_for: Business owners who want AI-summarized financials without learning a reporting tool.
tools.pricing: Plans from $38/mo (Simple Start) to $340/mo (Advanced) as of the August 2026 price update; Intuit Assist is bundled into paid tiers

tools.name: Tidio
tools.description: Live chat widget for your website with an AI chatbot (Lyro) that answers common customer questions automatically.
tools.best_for: Small storefronts or service businesses getting repetitive pre-sale questions on their website.
tools.pricing: Free plan available; Starter $29/mo; Lyro AI chatbot billed separately from $39/mo

tools.name: Freshdesk (Freddy AI)
tools.description: Help desk and ticketing software with an AI copilot (Freddy) that drafts replies and can resolve simple tickets on its own.
tools.best_for: Businesses with a real support queue, not just a contact form, that need to keep response times down.
tools.pricing: Pro plan $55/agent/mo; Freddy AI Copilot adds $29/agent/mo (500 AI sessions included, more at $49/100 sessions)

tools.name: Dialpad Ai
tools.description: Business phone system with built-in AI call transcription, live summaries, and coaching.
tools.best_for: Service businesses that spend a lot of time on the phone with customers and want automatic call notes.
tools.pricing: Standard plans from $15/user/mo; AI-heavy support tiers run $80-$150/user/mo

tools.name: Nextiva
tools.description: Unified phone, video, SMS, and chat platform with AI-generated call summaries and sentiment insights.
tools.best_for: Businesses that want one AI-assisted comms system instead of separate phone, chat, and SMS tools.
tools.pricing: Core $15/user/mo (annual); Engage $25/user/mo (annual); higher tiers for contact-center features

tools.name: HeyGen
tools.description: Turns a script into a talking-avatar video without filming anything — useful for product explainers or a faceless brand that occasionally wants a presenter.
tools.best_for: Businesses that want video content without being on camera or hiring a videographer.
tools.pricing: Free plan; Creator $29/mo; Pro $49/mo (4K export); Business $149/mo

tools.name: Loom
tools.description: Quick screen-and-webcam recording with AI-generated titles, summaries, and chapters, built for async video messages rather than polished edits.
tools.best_for: Businesses replacing long emails or meetings with a 2-minute recorded walkthrough.
tools.pricing: Free (25 videos, 5-min cap); Business $18/seat/mo; Business + AI $24/seat/mo

tools.name: Notion AI
tools.description: AI writing and Q&A built into Notion's workspace: summarize docs, draft pages, and search across your team's notes.
tools.best_for: Businesses that already run their operations out of Notion and want AI baked into that workspace.
tools.pricing: Bundled into the Business plan at $20/user/mo (annual); no longer sold as a standalone add-on

tools.name: Fathom
tools.description: AI meeting notetaker that joins your calls, transcribes them, and generates summaries and action items automatically.
tools.best_for: Anyone doing regular client or team calls who's tired of manually writing meeting notes.
tools.pricing: Free (5 AI summaries/mo); Premium $16/user/mo (annual)

tools.name: Motion
tools.description: AI calendar and task manager that automatically re-plans your day around deadlines and meetings.
tools.best_for: Solo founders juggling client work, admin, and deadlines with no assistant to manage their calendar.
tools.pricing: Pro $19/seat/mo (annual); Business $29/seat/mo (annual)

tools.name: Durable
tools.description: Generates a full small-business website (copy, images, layout) from a business description in under a minute, plus built-in CRM and invoicing.
tools.best_for: Businesses that need a website live now and don't want to hire a developer or learn a website builder.
tools.pricing: Free plan; Launch $22/mo (annual); Grow $85/mo (annual)

tools.name: folk
tools.description: Lightweight, AI-assisted CRM that builds contact records from your inbox and social profiles automatically instead of manual data entry.
tools.best_for: Relationship-driven businesses (agencies, consultants, realtors) that find traditional CRMs too heavy.
tools.pricing: Standard $24/user/mo (annual); no permanent free plan, 2-week trial only

tools.name: Descript
tools.description: Edits video and audio by editing the transcript — cut, remove filler words, even clone your own voice for corrections, no timeline scrubbing.
tools.best_for: Businesses producing podcast or video content who don't want to learn traditional editing software.
tools.pricing: Free plan; Hobbyist $16/user/mo (annual); Creator $24/user/mo (annual)
